exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Mara, yes, you need DOL's prior approval, for two reasons. (1) Cumulative transfers would be $110,000 + $95,000 = $205,000, more than the 10% of the $1,800,000 budget ($180,000) your award terms allow without approval (2 CFR 200.308(i)). (2) A subaward that wasn't in the approved application needs prior approval on its own (200.308(f)(6)). Send the request in the application's budget format and don't sign the subaward until DOL approves. One more thing: Cascade Pathways also has our state outreach contract AP-27-012, so the subaward's scope needs to be clearly different to avoid paying twice for the same outreach. Imani
